logic: [lib/scoring/signals/size.ts:L8-109] Counts files by walking from root (L25-66): skips every entry whose name starts with '.', skips paths ignored by a node-ignore matcher built from [node_modules, .git, vendor, target, dist, build, .next] plus the root .gitignore content (L8, L19-21, L50), max depth 8 (L10), stops past 10000 (L9).
